name: Gift flagged by the channel
actor: System (order ingestion through the source adapter)
trigger: An order arrives with a line the channel itself marks as free (IdoSell `orderSalesMode: gift`, WooCommerce GIFTiT meta `_free_gift=yes`, Mirakl FREE_ITEMS promotion).
preconditions: The connection is an OrderSource and its adapter knows the channel's flag field.
The gift line resolves to an OpenLinker variant (otherwise the whole order waits in awaiting_mapping, C-053).
mainFlow: The adapter reads the line and the channel flag.
The adapter emits the line with the paid unit price exactly as sent, `listUnitPriceGross` only when the channel states a real pre-discount price (otherwise null), and `taxRate`.

The adapter emits one order adjustment {source: channel, trigger: condition-of-sale, funder: as stated or unknown, form: free-units, qualifyingLineIds: as stated or unknown} with an allocation on the gift line.
Core persists line and adjustment; 'gift' is a derived view (line value fully covered by allocations, or form free-units), never a stored tax class (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md section 4).
Reservation, routing and sale decrement treat the gift as an ordinary line; it has its own channel line id and is safe on every key (r4/code/B-line-identity-traced.md section 0).
The pack bench shows the derived gift badge (G-09).
altFlows: Mirakl: free units may sit inside the same line's `quantity` (unknown). The adapter allocates `offered_quantity` units on that line and never invents a second line.
Flag present but price > 0 (GIFTiT `_price_for_gift`): the paid price is kept; the line is not shown as a free gift because allocations do not cover its value.
Gift SKU unmapped: the order goes to awaiting_mapping naming the gift line (C-053); a later automation on order.received will not fire for it (r5/6-design-and-code.md N-1, see G-06).
Unknown flag value (for example IdoSell `points`): not a gift. `points` is a redemption (trigger: redemption) or a payment, never an error (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md A1).

channelData.idosell: `productsResults[].orderSalesMode: "gift"` (also money, points); `bundleId` for sets; write side uses `productFree`. Whether a gift line's price is 0 or the real price is unknown (r4/phase1/3-pl-saas-and-erp.md PLS-07, PLS-12, line 143). No in-tree OL adapter (docs/architecture-overview.md, Module Organization).
channelData.woocommerce: Core: a 100% product coupon gives a line with `subtotal` = regular, `total` = 0, plus `coupon_lines[]` with no link to the line (SHOP-10). GIFTiT plugin: own line priced `_price_for_gift` (default 0, may be > 0), meta `_free_gift=yes`, `_free_gift_type`, `_rule_id_free_gift`; regular price not stored (SHOP-14, r4/phase1/2-own-shops.md section 5). OL's adapter reads neither `subtotal` nor `meta_data` (r4/code/B-line-identity-traced.md section 3).
channelData.mirakl: `order_lines.promotions[]` with `configuration.type: FREE_ITEMS`, `offered_quantity`, `deduced_amount`, `apportioned`; whether `quantity` includes the free units is unknown (r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 1.5, C-024). Empik seller enablement unknown (r5/3 C-024 row). No in-tree OL adapter.
channelData.prestashop: Not applicable: no flag; see G-03.

olBehaviour: Adapter work only: map the flag into the neutral adjustment and allocation. Core stores the adjustment and derives the gift view. No capability: absence of the field means 'channel did not say', and an adapter that does not read the flag simply emits none. Today no in-tree adapter reads any gift flag; IdoSell and Mirakl have no in-tree adapter at all (docs/architecture-overview.md, Module Organization), and the WooCommerce adapter does not read `meta_data` (r4/code/B-line-identity-traced.md section 3).

acceptance.given: a WooCommerce order with a GIFTiT line (`_free_gift=yes`, price 0.00) and one paid line
acceptance.then: the gift line carries an allocation of an adjustment with source channel and form free-units, `listUnitPriceGross` is null, and the order total equals the channel total

acceptance.given: a flagged gift line whose SKU has no mapping
acceptance.then: the order is awaiting_mapping and the unresolved reference names the gift line

acceptance.given: a GIFTiT line flagged as gift with `_price_for_gift` 5.00
acceptance.then: the line keeps its 5.00 paid price and is not shown as a free gift

priorityReason: No pilot channel flags gifts (Allegro C-008, PrestaShop C-012, Shoper PLS-05) and the two channels that do (IdoSell, Mirakl) have no in-tree adapter.
risks: Mirakl `quantity` vs `offered_quantity` semantics unknown: a wrong guess double-counts or drops free units.
BaseLinker anti-pattern to avoid: turning an IdoSell gift into 0.01 and moving value onto other lines (C-040).
IdoSell gift line price (0 or real) unknown; the adapter must not assume.

name: Gift not flagged: 0.00 line, one minor unit, or full price with a 100% discount
trigger: A line arrives whose paid value is zero or nominal, or whose discount equals its list value, with no channel gift flag.
preconditions: The adapter reads whatever pre-discount price and discount amounts the channel sends.
mainFlow: The adapter emits the paid unit price as sent and `listUnitPriceGross` only when the channel states a real pre-discount price (Shopify `originalUnitPriceSet`, eBay `lineItemCost`, WooCommerce `subtotal`).

The adapter emits one adjustment per channel promotion (id when sent, else synthetic) and allocations with an amount when the channel gives one (Shopify, eBay, Mirakl, Kaufland) or null when it does not (Allegro).

Core runs a pure classifier that labels the line `inferred-zero`, `inferred-nominal` (one minor unit via `minorUnitExponentFor`, never a literal 0.01) or `inferred-full-rebate` (r3/code/A-capability-design.md 2.2).
The label drives UI and the pack bench only; an inference never changes a fiscal document on its own (r3/code/A-capability-design.md 2.2, lesson P11).
altFlows: Allegro CAMPAIGN or ALLEGRO_PRICES: `originalPrice` equals `price` although a reduction happened, so `listUnitPriceGross` must be null, not `originalPrice` (r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-003 row and B).
Allegro ALLEGRO_PRICES with `reconciliation`: the platform-funded part is recorded with funder channel (r5/1-allegro-pl.md point 5, r5/3 A1 Art. 73).
Allegro 100% multipack unit inside a quantity > 1 line: probably averaged into `price`, so no zero line exists and no inference is possible (C-007 unverified edge).
Several discounts on one line (Allegro `discounts[]` is an array): several adjustments, per-reason amount null, never pick one reason (r5/1-allegro-pl.md C).
Allegro discount type BUNDLE does not mean a seller discount (C-004).
Allegro `price` and `originalPrice` are UNIT prices (verify/allegro-line-price.md Q1); how an n-th-unit MULTIPACK discount is expressed in one unit price is undocumented (same file, caveat).

channelData.allegro: No gift field or gift line in the checkout form; the only 'gift' string is the paid service GIFT_WRAP (C-008, r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-008 row). A free unit exists only as a MULTIPACK / CROSS_MULTIPACK discount up to 100%, reported as `lineItems[].discounts[{type: UNIT_PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT}]` with no amount (C-003, r4/phase1/1-allegro.md ALG-07/08). A 100% unit was 0.01 zl with a minimum commission in a 2020 moderator post (C-007, probable, amount unverified for 2026). Single-offer MULTIPACK ends 2027-01-12, CROSS_MULTIPACK stays (C-005).
channelData.shopify: BXGY free item is a normal line at full `originalUnitPriceSet` with `discountAllocations` equal to its value; no gift flag; the buyer adds it manually (r4/phase1/2-own-shops.md SHOP-16). No in-tree OL adapter.
channelData.woocommerce: Core: a 100% product coupon gives a line with `subtotal` = regular, `total` = 0, plus `coupon_lines[]` with no link to the line (SHOP-10). GIFTiT plugin: own line priced `_price_for_gift` (default 0, may be > 0), meta `_free_gift=yes`, `_free_gift_type`, `_rule_id_free_gift`; regular price not stored (SHOP-14, r4/phase1/2-own-shops.md section 5). OL's adapter reads neither `subtotal` nor `meta_data` (r4/code/B-line-identity-traced.md section 3).
channelData.ebay: `lineItemCost` before discounts, `appliedPromotions[]{discountAmount, promotionId}`; `giftDetails` is digital gift cards only (r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 1.6). No in-tree OL adapter.
channelData.amazon: `PromotionDiscount`, `PromotionIds` (v0); `ItemPromotionBreakdown.promotionId` (2026-01-01); no free-quantity field; `IsGift` is gift wrap / message (C-026, r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 1.2-1.3). No in-tree OL adapter.
channelData.kaufland: One `order_unit` per piece; `discounts[]{usage_type, discount_value}` carries seller-funded discounts only, Kaufland-funded promotions are invisible (r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 1.4, C-025). No in-tree OL adapter.
channelData.erli: No gift, free-quantity or bundle field (grep 0 hits). Line `unitPriceBeforeRebate`, order-level `rebate{id,name,code}` with no amount (r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 1.1). `unitPriceBeforeRebate` is not a list price (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md C-023 notes). Typed in OL, never read (C-023).

olBehaviour: Adapter fills neutral fields (field mechanism, three-state: null = unknown). Core owns one pure classifier. Today the Allegro wire type does not even declare `originalPrice` or `discounts` (r4/code/B-line-identity-traced.md section 3, C-002), so nothing is detected.

acceptance.given: a line with list price 50.00 and a discount allocation of 50.00
acceptance.then: the line is labelled inferred-full-rebate, the order total is unchanged, and no document setting changes because of the label alone

acceptance.given: an Allegro line with `discounts:[{type: CAMPAIGN}]` and `originalPrice` equal to `price`
acceptance.then: `listUnitPriceGross` is null, not equal to `originalPrice`

acceptance.given: a PLN line priced one grosz
acceptance.then: the line is labelled inferred-nominal and is never treated as a channel-asserted gift

priorityReason: Detection is differentiation, not damage prevention; the fiscal damage a zero line causes today is handled by stage0 cases G-17 and G-18 (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 5).
evidence: r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-003 row, B, C, F
risks: False positive: a genuinely cheap product at one minor unit labelled as a gift.
Filling `listUnitPriceGross` from Allegro `originalPrice` states a false 'no reduction' on CAMPAIGN and ALLEGRO_PRICES lines (r5/1-allegro-pl.md).
An OL operator discount rewrites `unitPriceGross` (#3543), so a reduction derived as list minus paid would mix channel and OL discounts (r5/6-design-and-code.md N-3).

name: Gift folded into a paid line (PrestaShop cart-rule gift)
trigger: A PrestaShop order is ingested whose applied cart rule has a `gift_product`, or a 100% `reduction_product`.
preconditions: The cart rule still exists when OL reads it, or a module snapshot of applied rules exists (r5/2-shops-erp.md section 2).
The gift product maps to an OL variant.
mainFlow: The adapter reads order rows (`id_order_detail`) and `order_cart_rules`.
For each applied rule the adapter reads `cart_rules/{id}`: `gift_product` / `gift_product_attribute`, or `reduction_product` with `reduction_percent` 100.

Gift product also bought: the adapter keeps the ONE merged row (quantity paid+1, full unit price) and adds an allocation of one unit's value with form free-units and quantity 1; it does not split the row (r5/2-shops-erp.md counterargument 4, verify/prestashop-live.md Q2).
Gift product not otherwise bought: its own row at full price gets an allocation equal to the row value (verify/prestashop-live.md Q1).
The order-level `discountTotal` is reduced by what was attributed, so lines plus remaining order discount reconcile to `total_paid_tax_incl` within the rounding tolerance.
altFlows: 100% `reduction_product` rule without `gift_product`: same shape live (both rows at full price, value only in `order_cart_rule`), target product only on the cart rule (verify/prestashop-live.md Q3).

One rule carries gift plus a percentage reduction: `order_cart_rule.value` is one sum; the gift part equals the gift's unit price (`CartRule.php:1555-1566`), the rest stays an order-level adjustment (SHOP-07).
Rule edited or deleted before OL reads it: the join is lost; the discount stays order-level, no gift is asserted, and the reason is recorded (r5/2-shops-erp.md extra cases).
A back-office edit adds a gift row after the order exists (`AddProductToOrderHandler.php:261-262`): detection must also run on order updates (r5/2-shops-erp.md, X-04).
`validateOrder` crashed mid-way: rows exist but no `order_cart_rule` row, so the gift cannot be detected at all (verify/prestashop-live.md order 6).

Rows minus discount differ from `total_paid_tax_incl` by one grosz (29.28 - 14.64 vs 14.63) and gift-rule value is 14.637 vs 14.640 for a percentage rule (verify/prestashop-live.md surprise 2): reconciliation must use a minor-unit tolerance.

channelData.prestashop: Cart-rule gift is a real `order_detail` row at FULL unit price with no gift marker; if the gift product is also bought it is the SAME row with quantity paid+1. Value only in `order_cart_rules.value` / `value_tax_excl` and `total_discounts_tax_incl`; the gift product only via `cart_rules/{id}.gift_product` (C-012; live on 9.0.2: verify/prestashop-live.md Q1-Q3). `orders.gift` is gift wrapping (verify/prestashop-live.md Q6).

olBehaviour: Adapter-only detection. Core must accept an allocation covering some units of a line: the proposed allocation needs a unit count for 'one of two units free' (r5/2 proposes `giftQuantity`), which the neutral model does not yet carry. Today the cart-rule discount stays order-level and 'never reaches a line' (r4/code/B-line-identity-traced.md section 3, `prestashop-order.mapper.ts:136-139`), and the mapper comment claiming a separate gift row is wrong for core PrestaShop (C-012, live-confirmed). A discount on no line fails the core line-sum check, so such an order's receipt is blocked, not wrong (C-030 confirmed in r5/8-tax-fiscal.md, `order-to-register-transaction-command.mapper.ts:136`). Own-shop orders are not routed (#3487), so stock is not at risk (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md D3).

acceptance.given: a PrestaShop order with 1 paid unit of X plus a cart-rule gift of X
acceptance.then: there is one line with quantity 2 and an allocation covering 1 unit, and no extra line

acceptance.given: a cart-rule gift of Y not otherwise bought
acceptance.then: Y's line keeps its full unit price with an allocation equal to its value and is shown as a gift

acceptance.given: a 100% `reduction_product` rule on Z
acceptance.then: Z's line carries an allocation equal to its value from that rule

acceptance.given: the cart rule was deleted before ingestion
acceptance.then: the discount stays order-level, no gift is asserted, and the order records why

priorityReason: Damage today is a visible document refusal rather than silent damage (C-030), stock is safe for unrouted own-shop orders, and whether the pilot client uses cart-rule gifts is an open client question (docs/plans/spike-bundles-and-gifts.md open questions).
risks: Returns cannot tell the free unit from the paid unit of a merged row.
PrestaShop prorates tax across gift and paid units (upstream #34085, r5/2-shops-erp.md line 43); OL must not copy that split onto documents.
The cart-rule join is fragile; the PrestaShop module snapshot at `actionValidateOrderAfter` is the exact alternative but needs a module release (r5/2-shops-erp.md section 2).
Live probe ran on 9.0.2 only; older versions rest on source reading (r5/2-shops-erp.md).

name: Gift promised only in the listing, absent from the order
trigger: An order arrives for an offer whose description promises a gift; the order has no gift line.
preconditions: The gift SKU exists in the master and has a stock position.
OL knows which offers promise which gift (operator knowledge, or a gift reference on the offer mapping).
mainFlow: The order arrives without the gift (C-008).
The operator (G-05) or a rule keyed on offer or variant (G-06) adds the gift line with source operator or rule, funder seller, form free-units.
Whoever adds it chooses the trigger: condition-of-sale (promised in the listing) or discretionary.
The gift is reserved, routed and decremented like any line; the bench shows it.
altFlows: Pilot: no add-line exists; the interim process G-20 (packer note plus manual stock correction) applies.
Allegro writebacks (waybill, refunds, returns) must skip the OL-added line (G-21).
Apilo pattern: the listed product becomes a set with the gift as a component, so every order carries it (r4/phase2/2-apilo.md G-04); in OL that is G-07.

channelData.allegro: No gift field or gift line in the checkout form; the only 'gift' string is the paid service GIFT_WRAP (C-008, r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-008 row). A free unit exists only as a MULTIPACK / CROSS_MULTIPACK discount up to 100%, reported as `lineItems[].discounts[{type: UNIT_PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT}]` with no amount (C-003, r4/phase1/1-allegro.md ALG-07/08). A 100% unit was 0.01 zl with a minimum commission in a 2020 moderator post (C-007, probable, amount unverified for 2026). Single-offer MULTIPACK ends 2027-01-12, CROSS_MULTIPACK stays (C-005). A description-only gift leaves no trace in the checkout form (r4/phase1/1-allegro.md ALG-15).

olBehaviour: Core only (an OL-added line); no adapter change. The trigger axis cannot be read from where the line came from: an operator-added gift can be a condition of the sale or an apology (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md A2), so the operator states it.

acceptance.given: an Allegro order for an offer mapped with gift SKU X and an active rule
acceptance.then: a line X with source rule and trigger condition-of-sale exists before the reservation runs

acceptance.given: an order with an OL-added gift line
acceptance.when: the waybill is relayed to Allegro
acceptance.then: only Allegro `lineItems` ids are sent

acceptance.given: the pilot without add-line
acceptance.when: the operator writes a packer note naming the gift
acceptance.then: the note is visible on the pack bench for that parcel

priorityReason: The pilot covers this with the zero-code G-20 process; a structured add needs an add-line writer that does not exist (C-057, r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 5).
risks: Allegro rules on gifts in thumbnails and on choosing recipients (r4/phase1/1-allegro.md S9, r4/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md section on thumbnails): an OL rule must not pick recipients at random.
Pilot-period gift orders leave no structured history (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 7 point 8).

name: Operator adds a gift line to an order
trigger: The operator uses an 'add gift' action on order detail.
preconditions: The order is ready, not shipped and not packed.
The gift variant has a stock position.
The order has no open amendment and no bought label (same gates as other edits).
mainFlow: The operator picks variant, quantity, trigger (condition-of-sale or discretionary) and optionally the qualifying lines.
Core writes an `addedLines` entry in the edit overlay; `orderSnapshot` stays the channel original (#3542 invariant, r5/6-design-and-code.md section 4).
The effective order gets a new line with paid price 0, `listUnitPriceGross` from the catalogue, and an adjustment {source: operator, form: free-units, funder: seller}.
A reservation is taken for the new line id.
On a routed order the line is added to the open work, or the edit is refused when the work is accepted or packed.
A timeline entry records who added what (X-06).
altFlows: Gift has no available-to-promise: refuse with a stock reason, or follow the G-08 policy.
Order already invoiced: totals do not change (price 0); only the G-10 treatment setting decides whether a new document shows it.
Operator removes the gift before packing: overlay entry removed, hold released.

channelData.all: None; the line exists only in OpenLinker.

olBehaviour: Core: a new overlay section and merge, an add-line method on the fulfilment work repository (none today, r4/code/C-stock-flows-traced.md (d)), and the edit writer moved from apps/api into core so automation can reuse it (r5/6-design-and-code.md N-2). Edits today can only lower quantities (C-057). No capability.

acceptance.given: a ready, unpacked order
acceptance.when: the operator adds gift X quantity 1
acceptance.then: `orderSnapshot` is unchanged, the effective order has a new 0.00 line X, and a hold exists for X

acceptance.given: a packed order
acceptance.then: the edit is refused with ORDER_PACKED and nothing is written

acceptance.given: an order with an added gift
acceptance.then: the invoice total equals the order total

priorityReason: No add-line exists anywhere and the writer must move into core; r5/7 sizes G-05 alone as an L (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 5).
risks: A line added after routing never reaches the bench without an add-to-work path (r4/code/C-stock-flows-traced.md (d) point 3).
Channel writebacks naming an OL-only line id fail (G-21).
Analytics rows are positional and cost carry-forward is keyed by productId|variantId, so a gift and a paid line of the same variant collide (r3/code/B-order-lines-and-documents.md line 243).

name: Automation rule adds a gift
trigger: order.received (T9) for an order matching the rule's conditions.
preconditions: An active rule with conditions (basket value, SKU in basket, channel, campaign dates) and a gift variant.
The order is ready (items resolved).
mainFlow: T9 fires after the effective order is computed and before reservation and routing (C-062, r4/code/C-stock-flows-traced.md (d)).
Conditions are evaluated; basket value and channel exist today, SKU-in-basket, per-line quantity and campaign window do not (r4/code/C-stock-flows-traced.md (d)).
A new action 'add line' writes the overlay entry with source rule, ruleId, trigger condition-of-sale and qualifyingLineIds.
Ingestion recomputes the effective order before reservation and routing, so the gift is reserved and routed with the rest.
The action is idempotent per (rule, order): a re-poll never adds a second gift.
altFlows: Order first parked in awaiting_mapping: T9 never fires on the retry today (r5/6-design-and-code.md N-1); the rule must run once when the order first becomes ready.
Gift per qualifying unit ('buy 2 TVs, get 2 soundbars', PrestaShop #32324 via r4/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-12): quantity derived from qualifying quantity.
Order cancelled or reduced below the threshold before packing: the gift is removed (r3/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-08).
Gift out of stock: G-08. Rule error: G-16.

channelData.all: None; conditions read OpenLinker's own order facts.

olBehaviour: Core automation: new action in `AutomationActionValues`, an irreversibility entry, legality on order.received, new condition fields and line facts (r4/code/C-stock-flows-traced.md (d)). No adapter work. Reuses the G-05 core writer.

acceptance.given: a rule 'order total >= 200 PLN adds X' and an order of 250 PLN
acceptance.then: exactly one X line with source rule exists before the reservation

acceptance.given: the same order re-polled
acceptance.then: no second X line is added

acceptance.given: an order first in awaiting_mapping that later becomes ready
acceptance.then: the rule runs once

priorityReason: Automation has no line action, line facts or reliable timing today (N-1); r5/7 places the gift epic in stage 3 (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 8).
risks: A silent miss on a qualifying order is a regulatory exposure (UK ASA Superdrug 2018, r4/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-14); C-066's 'frequent' claim is disputed (r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-066 row).
Threshold before or after discounts is ambiguous for merchants (r4/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-13).

name: Gift as a bundle component
trigger: A bundle line is ordered whose OpenLinker definition includes a gift component.
preconditions: Stage 1 bundle definitions exist (#3607).
The component is marked as gift with in-set price 0.
mainFlow: Expansion derives a component line id `{lineId}~g:{variantId}`; the role segment keeps it distinct from a paid component of the same variant (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md 4c).
The gift component is reserved, picked and decremented like other components.
Documents keep the bundle line (decided D3); the gift does not appear on documents by default.
altFlows: Gift component out of stock: bundle availability becomes 0 and the offer stops selling (Apilo side effect, r4/phase2/2-apilo.md G-08), unless a G-08 policy lets the bundle ship without it.
Component documents (D3c) later: the gift then needs the G-10 treatment setting.
IdoSell forbids the reverse (a gift that is itself a set: 'Towar Gratisowy nie moze byc zestawem'); Shopify limits a bundle by its scarcest component (verify/nested-and-gift-stockout.md surprise 5).

channelData.all: None; the composition is OpenLinker's own definition (C-027 as corrected: Allegro sends catalogue UUIDs only, r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-027 row).

olBehaviour: Core (bundle expansion). The only decision needed now is the `~g:` role segment in the derived id format, because ids land in terminal reservation rows and unique decrement keys (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md 4c, section 7 point 1).

acceptance.given: a bundle defined as A + B + gift G
acceptance.then: three component lines exist with ids ending `~c:A`, `~c:B`, `~g:G` and G is reserved

acceptance.given: a bundle whose paid and gift components are the same variant
acceptance.then: the two component ids differ and both decrement once

priorityReason: D3d is deferred; only the id role segment must be reserved in stage 1 (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 5).
risks: A cheap gift component that runs out stops sales of the whole bundle.
No competitor documents a zero-price component guarantee (r5/4-competitors-pl.md G-07 rows).

name: Gift runs out during a promotion
trigger: A rule or operator tries to add a gift whose available-to-promise is below the needed quantity.
preconditions: G-05 or G-06 exists.
The rule declares an out-of-stock policy.
mainFlow: Available-to-promise is checked when the gift is added.
The rule's policy applies: stop (no gift, attention plus timeline entry), substitute (a declared substitute variant), or allow (add and let the hold go short).
The outcome is never silent: the order shows which rule did not deliver and why.
Optionally the rule pauses itself once its gift pool is empty and tells the operator.
altFlows: Substitute also out of stock: falls back to stop.
The listing still advertises the gift (Allegro thread 1050074, r3/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-07): the attention text asks the operator to update the offer.
Buyer notification: out of scope; no competitor substitutes a gift or tells the buyer (verify/nested-and-gift-stockout.md claim 2).

Competitor policies seen: stop the offer (Shopify, IdoSell, Apilo set), block the action (Sellasist), wait silently (Brightpearl), add regardless (Linnworks) (verify/nested-and-gift-stockout.md surprise 4).
olBehaviour: Core plus a per-rule setting. Reuses available-to-promise (`IAvailabilityService`).

acceptance.given: a rule with policy stop and gift ATP 0
acceptance.then: no gift line is added and the order carries a visible attention entry naming the rule

acceptance.given: a rule with substitute S and gift ATP 0, S in stock
acceptance.then: S is added with the same adjustment

priorityReason: Depends on G-05/G-06; several competitors already stop or block, so only substitution and visibility are a gap (verify/nested-and-gift-stockout.md claim 2).
risks: 'Never silent' needs an attention reason that clears correctly; a stale reason is noise.

name: Gift visible on the pack bench and packing slip
trigger: A parcel containing a gift line is opened on the bench or a packing slip is printed.
preconditions: The gift is a line on the order (G-01, G-03, G-05, G-06) or a bundle component (G-07).
mainFlow: The bench shows the gift line with a 'Gift' badge from the derived view and its quantity.
The gift must be scanned like any item; the parcel cannot close short (same logic as a missing bundle component, r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 5).
The packing slip lists the gift without a price.
altFlows: Pilot: the gift is a packer note (`BenchParcelView.packerNotes`, `showToPacker`), not a line (G-20).
Hiding a gift from picking must be per line, never per product (Sellasist's product-level flag hides the product everywhere, r5/4-competitors-pl.md line 62).
olBehaviour: Core bench view plus frontend; reads the derived gift view.

acceptance.given: a parcel with a gift line
acceptance.then: the gift line shows a Gift badge and must be scanned before the parcel closes

acceptance.given: a product sold both normally and as a gift
acceptance.then: only the gift line carries the badge

priorityReason: Comes almost free once gift lines exist; the pilot uses packer notes (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 5).
risks: A gift that is only a note cannot be enforced at close.

name: Gift treatment on invoice and receipt (operator setting)
actor: Operator (chooses the treatment, with a tax adviser), system (issues the document)
trigger: A sales document is issued for an order containing a derived gift line.
preconditions: A per-connection or per-rule setting `giftTreatment` with the four neutral values below, the ADR-082 `freeDelivery` shape (r5/6-design-and-code.md 3.7). Treatment values (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section 5 and A1-A3): `priced-in` (the gift carries a positive share of what the buyer paid, split by list price, never above its own list price), `symbolic` (gift line at one minor unit), `gratuitous` (no line on the buyer's document, internal art. 7 ust. 2 record), `zero-line` (0.00 line or list price with a 100% rebate on the buyer's document).
The document provider declares its device limits: per-line rebate, zero line, zero-value rate group (r3/code/A-capability-design.md `LineRebateSupport`).
The gift line carries list price, its own VAT rate, purchase cost and the qualifying lines (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section 5).
mainFlow: The mapper reads the treatment and the provider's declared limits.

priced-in: a pure allocator splits the paid total proportionally by list price over the paid lines and the gift, never above the gift's own list price, remainder never leaving a rate bucket at 0.00; every line is a normal positive line at its own rate (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A1, section 4; KIS 2015/2016 S7/S8; BFH XI R 19/23).
symbolic: the gift line is priced at one minor unit at its own rate (two 2026 KIS rulings accept 1 grosz as the base, r5/8-tax-fiscal.md S9; eparagony accepts it, probe d1).
gratuitous: the gift is left off the buyer's invoice and receipt and goes to the internal record of G-19.

zero-line: the gift is printed at 0.00 or at list price with a 100% line rebate (eparagony `rebatesMarkups` or `REBATE` with `taxRate`; KSeF `P_10`), only where the provider declares it and the gift's rate has positive paid value on the same document.
Any combination the provider cannot render is held with a named reason; nothing is guessed (ADR-041, r3/code/A-capability-design.md).
altFlows: zero-line is the highest-risk treatment: KIS 0114-KDIP1-1.4012.876.2025.2.IZ (23.01.2026) classed exactly this shape (0 zl / 100% rebate, 'gratisy beda dokumentowane ... jako produkty z rabatem 100%') as a free supply under art. 7 ust. 2, taxed on purchase price at the gift's own rate and not documented by an invoice (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-033, Headline). Offer it only behind an explicit adviser acknowledgement.

Omitting the gift or moving its value onto a paid line without the gratuitous treatment: harmless when the gift shares the paid line's rate, over-declares when the gift's rate is lower, under-declares when it is higher. When rates differ the document is refused with a named reason (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section 'The proposed rule, tested' (2), A3; verify/eparagony-gift-forms.md test 2).

A document-level `REBATE` without `taxRate` spreads proportionally across rates; that is right only for a priced-in gift and the merchant cannot choose the split (C-029 disputed in r5/8-tax-fiscal.md). Use rate-scoped `REBATE` lines.
Do `P_10` in KSeF for ordinary discounts only; gifts use allocated prices (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A5).

Italy taxes a contractual free good at a higher rate than the goods sold and renders it as full value plus a negative line; country rules live in config or adapters, never core (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md A2, A6; r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-036).

channelData.all: Document providers, not channels: eparagony `lines[].rebatesMarkups`, `REBATE` with `taxRate` A-G, zero-bucket refusal errorCode 41 (verify/eparagony-gift-forms.md, r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-028); KSeF FA(3) `P_9A`/`P_11` may be 0, `P_10` exists but OL never emits it (C-037); Subiekt rebate pair only on the ZK order path (C-038). Receipt content: Dz.U. 2025 poz. 845 par. 26 for kasy with copy, Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1654 par. 22 for on-line kasy (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-031).

olBehaviour: Setting decides the treatment; core owns one pure allocator for priced-in and symbolic (beside `reconcileDiscountRounding`); providers declare device limits. r5/6 argues the limits should be a required method on `InvoicingPort` and `FiscalizationPort`, not an optional guard-only capability, because absence must not license silent omission (r5/6-design-and-code.md 3.6, section 4). The treatment names are neutral; no national vocabulary enters core (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A2). Until an operator chooses, the default is today's behaviour plus the G-18 guards; a tax treatment is never a core default (verify/standard-stress-test.md B, ADR-063, ADR-026).

acceptance.then: A prints 80.00 at 23%, the gift prints 20.00 at 8%, the total is 100.00 and no line exceeds its list price

acceptance.given: treatment symbolic and a gift at 8% with a paid line at 23%
acceptance.then: the gift prints at 0.01 at 8% and the paid line is reduced by 0.01 so the total equals what the buyer paid

acceptance.given: treatment gratuitous
acceptance.then: the invoice has no gift line and the gift appears in the G-19 record with purchase cost and its own rate

acceptance.given: no gratuitous treatment and a gift whose rate differs from every paid line
acceptance.when: the mapper would omit or merge it
acceptance.then: the document is held with a named reason and no request reaches the provider

priorityReason: Rulings conflict (KIS 2026 vs 2015/2016) and the merchant's treatment needs a tax adviser; the minimum fiscal safety for the pilot is stage0 G-18 (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md, r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 8 stage 3).
evidence: r5/8-tax-fiscal.md Headline, C-028, C-029, C-031, C-033, C-037, 'The proposed rule, tested', A1-A6
risks: Whether a proportionally allocated gift price is a real price or an artificial split under art. 29a is unresolved (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md conflicts).
priced-in changes what operators and buyers see (the gift is no longer '0 zl') and needs a list price for every gift (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A1).
ADR-082 decision 7 says a receipt never carries a zero line (docs/architecture/adrs/082-delivery-line-on-sales-documents.md:21), which argues against zero-line on receipts.
Novitus kills a product name whose rate goes down then up; gift names must keep one rate (verify/eparagony-gift-forms.md header).
Comarch Optima refuses 0 lines (C-032); a symbolic or allocated price travels further (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-032).

name: Gift and returns
trigger: A return of goods that qualified for a gift, with the gift kept or returned.
preconditions: The gift is a line with a declared list value and qualifyingLineIds.
mainFlow: The return resolves to channel lines as today.
The refund proposal shows the gift's declared value, the qualifying lines and whether the gift came back.
The operator decides any deduction; OL never deducts automatically.
A returned gift is restocked like any line.
altFlows: Allegro returns are keyed by offerId and quantity (C-010); an OL-added gift has no offerId and never appears in a channel return, so its custody is recorded in OL only.
Withdrawal vs complaint: Allegro moderators say the gift must come back on withdrawal only if the offer said so (r4/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-16); buyers argue otherwise.
Partial return drops the order below the threshold (Allegro multipack thread, r4/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-17 area).

channelData.allegro: Returns: `CustomerReturnItem{offerId, quantity, ...}`, no gift concept (r4/phase1/1-allegro.md, C-010).
channelData.erli: Returns by positional item index with quantity (r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 1.1).
channelData.kaufland: Returns per order unit, refund amount per unit (r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 1.4).

olBehaviour: Core (returns and refund proposal) reading the adjustment links. No adapter change.

acceptance.given: an order with a paid line and a rule gift, the buyer returns the paid line only
acceptance.then: it shows the gift's declared value as a possible deduction and proposes none by default

acceptance.given: an Allegro return of the paid offer on an order with an OL-added gift
acceptance.then: the return names only the channel line and the gift's custody is recorded separately in OL

priorityReason: The legal answer is unknown (r4/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md open question 1) and no competitor automates it (r5/4-competitors-pl.md G-11 rows).
risks: Any automatic deduction may be unlawful for a non-conformity claim.

name: Gift reporting and small-gift records
trigger: A report or export is requested for gifts given in a period, campaign or rule.
preconditions: Gifts are lines with adjustments (not notes).
A purchase cost exists for the gift variant (ADR-080 `netUnitCost` / `unitCostNet` snapshot).
mainFlow: OL lists gift lines per rule, campaign or operator with quantity, list value, purchase cost at transfer date, rate, recipient key and date.
OL exports per-recipient yearly totals of purchase cost; thresholds are not in core.

A country policy (operator config) applies thresholds; for Poland the small-gift exclusion is 20 zl net purchase cost per unit without a register (since 1.01.2021, SLIM VAT) or 100 zl net per person per year with a register (art. 7 ust. 3-4, Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1263; r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-034).
The exclusion only matters for gifts with the gratuitous treatment; a priced-in gift is a paid supply (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-034 precision b).
altFlows: Cost missing: the gift reads 'cost unknown', never 'under 20 zl' (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A4); a line ingested without cost stays no-cost (#3588, r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 7).
Allegro buyer email is a per-transaction alias, so the recipient key must be the resolved customer, not the email (r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-067 row).
`OL_STORE_PII=false` (hash-only): a named per-person register conflicts with it and needs a design decision (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section 5).
olBehaviour: Core read model over adjustments and the existing cost snapshot, keyed on cost not list price; thresholds in operator config or a country pack (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md A5, r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A4).

acceptance.given: three gratuitous gifts with purchase cost 12.00 net each for one customer in 2026
acceptance.then: it shows three gifts, the customer's yearly total of 36.00 net cost, and the treatment of each

acceptance.given: a gift variant without a recorded cost
acceptance.then: the gift shows 'cost unknown' and is not counted as under any threshold

priorityReason: Needs gift lines and a treatment first; no merchant asked for a gift-cost report (r3/phase1/5-merchant-voice.md PAIN-18).
evidence: C-034 (resolved: 20 zl since 2021, on purchase cost)
risks: Cost carry-forward keyed productId|variantId collides when a gift and a paid line share a variant (r3/code/B-order-lines-and-documents.md line 243).
A per-person register stores PII that hash-only installs refuse to keep.

name: Gift wrap and 'is a gift' order (not a free item)
trigger: An order carries a paid gift-wrap service or an 'is a gift' flag with a message.
preconditions: The adapter reads the service or flag.
mainFlow: Allegro: the adapter maps `selectedAdditionalServices[{definitionId: GIFT_WRAP, price (per unit), quantity}]` to a service charge (price x quantity) so lines plus charges reconcile to `summary.totalToPay` (verify/allegro-line-price.md Q1 arithmetic 76.00 x 2 + 10.00 x 2 + 15.87 = 187.87).
PrestaShop: `orders.gift`, `gift_message` and the order-level `total_wrapping_tax_incl` / `_tax_excl` are mapped to a packing instruction plus a service charge (verify/prestashop-live.md Q6).
Amazon `IsGift` / `giftOption`: packing instruction and message only, never a free item.
The bench shows the wrap instruction and message; documents carry the paid service.
altFlows: Today the Allegro wire type does not declare `selectedAdditionalServices`; the wrap money surfaces only as a shipping fallback (when `delivery.cost` is absent) or as a negative gap that `discountTotal` ignores (verify/allegro-line-price.md code section, r5/1-allegro-pl.md point 6). Code reading; not tested on a live order.

PrestaShop: the OL mapper reads `total_paid_tax_incl` and `total_shipping_tax_incl` but no wrapping field is listed among what it reads (r4/code/B-line-identity-traced.md section 3), so the wrap charge is probably outside the lines too (inference, unverified).

olBehaviour: Adapter fields: a neutral order charge (service) and a packing instruction. Core documents render the charge like delivery (ADR-082 shape). No capability.

name: NEW Rounding and delivery remainders must not land on a zero-priced gift line
trigger: A receipt or invoice is built for an order with a 0.00 line and either a discount rounding gap or a delivery spread remainder.
preconditions: The order has at least one line whose paid gross is 0.
mainFlow: `reconcileDiscountRounding` picks the first quantity-1 goods line whose paid gross is greater than 0 (today it accepts a 0.00 line when the gap is positive, `discount-rounding.types.ts:65-67`).
`spreadDeliveryAcrossLines` picks the largest paid quantity-1 line and never a 0.00 line (today a gift that is the only quantity-1 line gets the remainder, `delivery-line.types.ts:581-587`).
If no paid candidate exists, the document is held with a named reason instead of putting the cent on the free line.
altFlows: The stray cent today accidentally keeps eparagony from refusing a zero rate bucket; removing it without G-18 turns a wrong receipt into a blocked one (r5/6-design-and-code.md C-056 row). Ship together with G-18.

channelData.all: Any channel that sends a 0.00 line (WooCommerce, GIFTiT, Shoper apps) or any OL-added gift.

olBehaviour: Core pure functions in sales-documents; about ten lines plus tests (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 5).

acceptance.given: paid line A 10.00 quantity 2, gift G 0.00 quantity 1 listed first, and a discount with a positive 1-grosz rounding gap
acceptance.then: G stays 0.00 and the grosz lands on A

acceptance.given: delivery spread mode where G is the only quantity-1 line
acceptance.then: the remainder does not land on G

acceptance.given: an order whose only quantity-1 lines are 0.00 and a remainder exists
acceptance.then: the document is held with a named reason

priorityReason: A live wrong document on the pilot stack today (a free item printed at 0.01), fixed in a few lines (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md D5 and section 6).
risks: Narrower than first stated: only when the gift is the first quantity-1 line with a positive gap, or the only quantity-1 line in spread mode (r5/6-design-and-code.md C-056 row).
Without G-18 the fix exposes errorCode 41.

name: NEW A zero-value gift on a fiscal receipt: never send a zero VAT bucket, refuse cross-rate omission with a named reason
actor: System (receipt mapper and eparagony adapter), operator
trigger: A receipt is built for an order containing a goods line whose paid value is 0, or a rebate that would zero a VAT rate.
preconditions: The fiscal provider is eparagony (pilot) or another receipt adapter.
No gift treatment setting exists yet (G-10 is later).
mainFlow: The mapper computes the paid value per VAT rate after rebates.

A zero-value line that shares its rate with a positive paid line is left off the receipt and the order timeline records it. The tax effect is the same as printing it (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md 'The proposed rule, tested' (2): same rate is harmless); omission matches ADR-082 decision 7 ('A receipt never carries a zero line', docs/architecture/adrs/082-delivery-line-on-sales-documents.md:21) and art. 7 ust. 2 supplies are exempt from the kasa (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1902 zal. poz. 46, r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-033).

A zero-value line alone in its rate (no paid line at that rate) is not omitted and not sent: the receipt is held with a named, operator-readable reason ('gift in a different VAT rate than the paid goods: choose how to document it'), because omission would over- or under-declare VAT (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section (2) and A3).

Before calling eparagony the adapter refuses any payload in which a VAT rate's value after rebates is <= 0, so the raw HTTP 400 errorCode 41 never reaches the operator (verify/eparagony-gift-forms.md, r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-028).
Basket discounts are sent only as `REBATE` lines carrying `taxRate` (verify/eparagony-gift-forms.md test 4).
altFlows: Never 'move value' onto the gift (verify/eparagony-gift-forms.md test 2) and never leave 0.01 in the gift's rate as a side effect (test 3b): accepted by eparagony but they misstate VAT or the total. A deliberate 1-grosz gift line is the G-10 `symbolic` treatment, not this case.
Held receipt: the operator can issue it after choosing a treatment (G-10 later) or by hand; during the pilot this is no worse than today, where eparagony refuses the same receipt (C-028).
Other receipt providers: zero-line behaviour unverified; Comarch Optima refuses 0 lines (C-032).
Invoices are out of this case: KSeF `P_11` may be 0 (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-037); see G-10.

channelData.all: Document provider eparagony: refuses a VAT letter whose sales total would be 0.00 with HTTP 400 errorCode 41 'Incorrectly calculated value of eReceipt.lines[n]'; accepts a 0.00 line or 100% line rebate when a positive line shares its letter (probes a1, b1, a8, b8; verify/eparagony-gift-forms.md tests 1-5; r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-028). This is provider behaviour, not law: Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1654 par. 35 pkt 3 bans only a negative per-rate value (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-028).

olBehaviour: Core receipt mapper rule plus a new named block reason (one more `SalesDocumentBlockOutcome` value, r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A3), and an adapter pre-call guard in the eparagony package (ADR-082 decision 9 shape). No new capability for stage0.

acceptance.then: the receipt carries only A, totals 10.00, and the order timeline says the gift was not printed

acceptance.then: no request is sent to eparagony and the receipt is held with the named cross-rate reason

acceptance.given: any payload where one VAT rate nets to 0 after rebates
acceptance.when: the adapter is about to call eparagony
acceptance.then: no request is sent and the operator sees a readable reason instead of errorCode 41

priorityReason: The pilot fiscal provider today refuses a receipt with a cross-rate gift behind an opaque error (C-028 live, r5/7-scope-overengineering.md D6); a named reason and a harmless same-rate omission are a few lines.
evidence: r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-028, C-031, C-033, 'The proposed rule, tested' (2), A3
risks: Same-rate omission is tax-neutral, but if the merchant's facts look like KIS 2026 and the gift costs more than 20 zl, VAT on the gift itself may still be due under art. 7 ust. 2; omission does not cure that (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section (2)); see G-19.
Held cross-rate receipts need an operator path until G-10 exists.

The stress test (written before r5/8) calls omission the only safe receipt option (verify/standard-stress-test.md D5); r5/8 narrows that to same-rate gifts or a declared gratuitous treatment, which is why cross-rate omission is refused here.
ADR-082 decision 7 is written for delivery lines; applying it to goods lines is a reading (r5/6-design-and-code.md section 4).

name: NEW Gratuitous gift recorded outside the buyer's documents (art. 7 ust. 2 record)
trigger: A gift has the gratuitous treatment (G-10), for example a merchant who follows KIS 2026 or a discretionary apology gift.
preconditions: Gift lines carry list price, purchase cost at transfer date, own VAT rate, recipient and date (G-12).
mainFlow: The gift is not printed on the buyer's invoice or receipt: KIS 2026 says art. 7 ust. 2 supplies are not documented by an invoice, and they are exempt from the kasa (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1902 zal. poz. 46, until 31.12.2027) (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md C-033).

OL produces an internal record per gift: base = purchase price or production cost at transfer (art. 29a ust. 2), the gift's own VAT rate, recipient key, date, promotion id and terms version, treatment and who chose it (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section 5).
The small-gift exclusion (20 zl purchase cost per unit, or 100 zl yearly with a register) is applied by the operator's country policy, outside core (G-12).
The record is exported for the accounting system or JPK; OL computes no tax.
altFlows: The operator chooses priced-in or symbolic instead: no record; the gift is a paid supply on the documents (G-10).

Italy routes own-stock free goods to a self-invoice (TD27) and excludes contractual sconto merce unless the gift's rate is higher (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md A6, r4/phase1/4-marketplaces-and-law.md 2.7).
olBehaviour: Core export over adjustments and cost snapshots; the treatment is operator config, the thresholds a country pack (r5/3-marketplaces-countries.md A5, r5/8-tax-fiscal.md A2).

acceptance.given: a gratuitous gift with purchase cost 12.00 net at 8%
acceptance.then: it lists the gift with base 12.00, rate 8%, the recipient key and the promotion

acceptance.given: a gratuitous gift
acceptance.when: the buyer's receipt and invoice are issued
acceptance.then: neither carries the gift line

Gratuitous gifts above 20 zl cost create output VAT with no revenue; the merchant must see that cost (r5/8-tax-fiscal.md section (2)).

name: NEW Interim pilot gift process: packer note plus manual stock correction
trigger: During the pilot an order needs a gift that is not on the order.
preconditions: Order notes with `showToPacker` and manual stock correction (#3566) are available.
mainFlow: The operator adds an order note naming the gift with `showToPacker` on.
The packer sees it in `BenchParcelView.packerNotes` and puts the gift in the parcel.
The operator records a manual stock correction for the gift SKU with a reason.
The process is written down for the pilot client.
altFlows: Correction forgotten: gift stock drifts until the next master sync or count.
olBehaviour: No code; uses shipped notes and manual correction (docs/architecture-overview.md: order notes `showToPacker`, manual stock correction #3566).

acceptance.given: an order note with `showToPacker`
acceptance.then: the note is visible

acceptance.given: a manual correction of -1 on the gift SKU
acceptance.then: it shows a manual_correction row with the operator's reason

priorityReason: Zero code and it prevents the pilot's missed-packing risk for description-only gifts (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md D7, section 6 item 4).
risks: No structured gift history; G-12 starts empty (r5/7-scope-overengineering.md section 7 point 8).
Notes are free text; a later G-05 imports nothing from them.

name: NEW OpenLinker-added gift lines are skipped by channel writebacks
trigger: Any writeback that names order lines runs for an order with an OL-added line (waybill relay, refunds, returns, commission refund).
preconditions: G-05 or G-06 added a line that the channel does not know.
mainFlow: Writebacks build their line list from the channel snapshot only.
OL-added lines are filtered out before any call.
The OL-added line's shipment and return are tracked in OL only.
altFlows: Destination mirror (a PrestaShop order created by OL): whether the gift is sent as a 0.00 line is a destination question, unverified; under OMS routing the sale decrement lowers its stock instead.
Allegro waybill without `lineItems` means 'every item' (C-009), so omission is safe.

channelData.allegro: Waybill `lineItems[]{id}` only (C-009); returns by offerId (C-010); `RefundClaimRequest` by `lineItem.id` (r5/1-allegro-pl.md C-010 row).

olBehaviour: Core filter in three writebacks reading `channelSnapshot` (the #3542 split already forces this distinction).

acceptance.given: an Allegro order with one channel line and one OL-added gift
acceptance.then: the request names only the channel line id and succeeds

acceptance.given: a buyer return on Allegro for an order with an OL-added gift
acceptance.then: no OL-only line id is sent to Allegro

priorityReason: Only reachable once OL can add lines (G-05/G-06).
risks: A writeback that reads effective lines would send an id the channel rejects (loud, not silent).
